description: Design-pinned libbox and toolchain build inputs for macos15-network-extension-migration (Requirement 5.1). This manifest is the offline source of truth; verify_pinned_build_inputs.py binds it to scripts/dependency_pins.env, the tracked patch files, the native dependency lock, and the offline build scripts.

requiredInstallerFragments: the temporary directory must use its canonical physical path
the temporary directory must belong to the release account
the temporary directory must not be group- or other-writable

required.reason: QUIC-based outbounds (Hysteria2, TUIC, and QUIC transports) are product features.
uTLS client fingerprints are required by the supported TLS outbounds.

box.New sets needClashAPI whenever a platform log writer is installed and daemon/instance.go always installs one, so without this tag include/clashapi_stub.go fails every engine start with 'clash api is not included in this build'.
The pinned Go toolchain requires the upstream linkname escape hatch used by sing-box.
tfo-go requires the matching -checklinkname=0 build configuration.
Drops the gRPC trace surface that the product never exposes.

engineStartPathBindings.reason: The application-owned experimental.clash_api projection block is only served by the real clash API server, which exists in the artifact only when with_clash_api is pinned.
Every projected configuration carries the controller block, so every engine start needs the clash API server compiled in.
